_comment: Mock job postings for the AgenticJob POC. Descriptions are intentionally full of marketing 'fluff' so the /scan skill has something to summarize away. Not real jobs.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a rockstar 10x ninja engineer who breathes clean code and eats scaling challenges for breakfast?! Acme Corp is a fast-paced, mission-driven, synergy-fueled unicorn disrupting the payments space. We offer free snacks, a foosball table, and unlimited PTO (that nobody takes). In this role you will build and scale our Go-based payment APIs, own distributed systems handling millions of transactions, and mentor junior engineers. Requirements: 5+ years backend experience, strong Go, and solid distributed-systems fundamentals.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (React)
jobs.description: Join our world-class, award-winning, category-defining team of passionate innovators! Bright Labs is looking for a wizard who will delight our users with pixel-perfect experiences. You will build and maintain our React + TypeScript web app, collaborate with designers, and improve performance and accessibility. We have kombucha on tap and a dog-friendly office. Requirements: 3+ years frontend, strong React and TypeScript, an eye for UX.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Do you dream in SQL and wake up thinking about pipelines? Nimbus Analytics is a hyper-growth, data-obsessed, customer-first powerhouse changing how enterprises make decisions. You will design and maintain ETL pipelines, model data warehouses, and ensure data quality across the org. Perks include a learning budget and an annual company retreat in the Alps. Requirements: 4+ years data engineering, strong SQL and Python, experience with a modern warehouse (Snowflake/BigQuery) and orchestration (Airflow/dbt).

jobs.title: DevOps / Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Calling all infrastructure heroes! Vertex Systems is a bold, relentless, future-forward scale-up on a rocketship trajectory. You will own our Kubernetes platform, build CI/CD pipelines, manage cloud infrastructure as code, and champion reliability. We believe in work hard, play hard, and there's a rooftop bar. Requirements: 4+ years in DevOps/SRE, Kubernetes, Terraform, and a major cloud (AWS/GCP).

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: We're on a bold mission to revolutionize healthcare and we want a visionary storyteller to join our tribe of changemakers! At Lumen Health, no two days are the same. You will own the product roadmap for our patient-facing app, run discovery with users, and partner closely with engineering and design to ship outcomes that matter. Requirements: 4+ years product management, experience shipping consumer products, strong analytical and communication skills; healthcare experience a plus.
